update.title: Psa 116:9 and 1Sa 17:19 removed from the narrative
update.researcher_instruction: just remove 1 Sam 17:19 from the narative, it has no relevance;  Ps 116:9 is also not relevant and can be removed.
update.method: Ch 2: the Psalm 116 citation ends at verse 8; the quoted words of 116:9 ('I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living') are removed with it. Ch 4: '(17:17-20)' becomes '(17:17-18, 20)'.
